history_short: Sihphir Kohhran din rualin Kohhran Hmeichhia hi a ding ve nghal em tih hriat theih ni lo mah se hruaitu hmasate hriat danin kum 1949 vel khan Kohhran Hmeichhia hi ding tawh ngeiin hriat a ni a.

A hranin inkhawmte pawh an lo nei tawh thin a, Committee-te pawh an lo thu tawh thin a. Kohhran rawngbawlna tichaktu  pawimawh tak niin kum 2025 hian Member 771 an ni mek.
